definitions.meaning: A flesh-tawer or tormentor, an executioner

quotations.old_english: Hyldere, oððe cwellere, oððe flǽsctawere [MS. flæctawere]
quotations.latin: lānio, vel lānista, vel carnifex, vel macellārius

source_text: flǽsc-tawere, es; m. A flesh-tawer or tormentor, an executioner; l&a-short;nio, carn&i-short;fex :-- Hyldere, oððe cwellere, oððe flǽsctawere [MS. flæctawere] l&a-short;nio, vel l&a-short;nista, vel carn&i-short;fex, vel m&a-short;cell&a-long;rius, Ælfc. Gl. 113; Som. 79, 120; Wrt. Voc. 60, 27.
